title: redeem-request
description: POST /api/v1/licence/redeem body. (a) A key typed or pasted at a linked till. (b) Since 2026-09-28: a till holding a local key reports it once (keyType token, installCode, installId) - no branch key needed.

key.description: Either a portal licence key (any format the portal chooses, e.g. SSPK-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) or a whole SSPOS1 token (a local key being reported: the token the till holds). The till trims spaces.

keyType.description: token when the text starts with SSPOS1., else portalKey. A courtesy - the portal may detect it itself.

licenceId.description: The licence the till holds now.

approverKids.description: Built-in kids whose signer certificates this till accepts (docs/web-portal-api.md 17.17). Sign a returned token with a kid in trustedKids, or with your certified key when its certificate approvedBy is in this list.

installCode.description: This till's install code. For a local key report the portal records licenceId -> installCode on first sighting.

installId.description: This PC's install id (sent by tills from 2026-09-28; older tills omit it). Record it with the installCode.

deviceName.description: The PC's name (sent by tills from 2026-09-28; older tills omit it).

appVersion.description: The till's version (sent by tills from 2026-09-28).

os.description: Windows name, version and architecture (sent by tills from 2026-09-28).

tillClockUtc.description: The till's clock when the request was first sent; a retry with the same Idempotency-Key repeats it (docs/web-portal-api.md 17.11 rule 5).
